biography: Born in a small village near Silverstone, Tom Woodcock's racing journey began with a battered go-kart he rebuilt with his father. He showed early promise at local karting events, catching the eye of a Caterham scout. Lacking the deep pockets of many aspiring racers, Tom clawed his way up the ranks through sheer determination and a knack for squeezing every last drop of performance from his machinery. A defining moment came at Oulton Park in 2018 when, starting from the back of the grid in a rain-soaked Supersport race, he carved his way through the field to take a stunning victory. Despite multiple offers from higher formulas, Tom remains fiercely loyal to Caterham, feeling a connection to the grassroots racing that nurtured his talent. He is highly respected in the paddock, known for his unwavering focus and almost unnerving calmness under pressure. Currently, he's looking to finally clinch the Caterham Supersport championship, a title that has narrowly eluded him for several seasons.
drivingStyle: Tom's driving style is characterized by calculated precision and a defensive posture. He is not one for flamboyant overtaking maneuvers, preferring to maintain a consistent pace, protect his tires, and capitalize on the mistakes of others. He is exceptionally skilled at reading track conditions and adapting his driving accordingly, often finding grip where others cannot. While some may perceive his approach as cautious, it is undeniably effective, particularly in endurance races where consistency and reliability are paramount. He is known for his exceptional race craft, choosing his battles wisely and using the full width of the track to defend his position.

rivalries.name: James Thornton
rivalries.reason: A fierce on-track rivalry stemming from a controversial collision at Brands Hatch in 2021, where Thornton accused Woodcock of deliberately blocking him.

rivalries.name: Sarah McKinley
rivalries.reason: A strategic rivalry; McKinley's team is a constant threat for the team championship, making every on-track battle a high-stakes chess match.

rivalries.name: Ben Carter
rivalries.reason: A personal rivalry fueled by their shared history in karting; both drivers constantly strive to outdo each other.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky pair of socks on race day, regardless of the weather.
Refuses to drive a car with a number ending in '3'.
Meticulously cleans his visor before every session, even if it's already spotless.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about taking risks; it's about calculating them."
careerHighlight: Winning the 2018 Oulton Park Supersport race from last place in torrential rain, showcasing exceptional car control and racecraft.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead on the final lap of the 2020 Caterham Supersport championship decider, handing the title to his rival, James Thornton.
